recognize_zh: 兩顆大小不一的非典型淋巴樣細胞，核呈腎形或凹陷，細胞質淡藍且在核凹處聚集細小嗜天青顆粒，較大那顆明顯大於正常大顆粒淋巴球，提示腫瘤性 NK 細胞。
features: Two atypical lymphoid cells, one large and one medium-sized
Moderate N:C ratio with pale blue, partly clear cytoplasm
Reniform/indented nuclei with the granules nestled in the nuclear hof
Fine to slightly granular chromatin; small nucleolus visible in the smaller cell
Fine azurophilic granules concentrated in a paranuclear zone
describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation shows two isolated atypical lymphoid cells of variable size. Both have indented, kidney-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with a paranuclear collection of fine azurophilic granules; the larger cell exceeds the size of a normal large granular lymphocyte. The morphology indicates atypical granular (NK/cytotoxic) lymphoid cells; immunophenotyping (surface CD3-, cytoplasmic CD3+, CD56+) and EBER in situ hybridization are needed. Findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are uniformly small with round mature nuclei and condensed chromatin, and are EBER-negative.
Cytology is similar; distinction rests on the systemic leukemic presentation rather than morphology.
Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles and lacy folded chromatin, and are CD14+ rather than CD56+/cytoplasmic CD3+.
